description: Application under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment to planning permission DC/25/138944, dated 16 May 2025, seeking to vary Condition (2) (Approved Plans) to allow the following minor amendments: Replacement of brick finishes to the caf‚ piers with metal cladding due to structural weight constraints; Introduction of an additional shopfront on the garden centre-facing elevation of the caf‚; Minor stepping of the rear elevation of the former Homebase building to achieve appropriate waterproofing detailing; Adjustment of the fence line adjacent to the south-east caf‚ elevation, moving it closer to the pond to reduce visibility of the retained slab; and Enclosure of caf‚ services within the revised fenced area, removing the need for a separate services enclosure fence at Former Homebase, 10 Beckenham Hill Road SE6.
site_name: HOMEBASE, 10 BECKENHAM HILL ROAD, BROMLEY, SE6 3NU
